initialExam.title: LIC AAO (Assistant Administrative Officer) 2026
initialExam.description: LIC AAO recruitment for administrative officer positions in India's largest life insurance company. Notification expected August 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Reasoning (35Q), English (30Q), Quant (35Q). Mains: Reasoning (30Q), English (30Q), Quant (30Q), GK/Current Affairs (30Q), Insurance/FM (30Q) + Descriptive English.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100Q, 70 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 150Q + Descriptive, 300+25 marks. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Administrative Officer in LIC of India
initialExam.careerGrowth: AAO → AO → ADM → DM → SDM → ZM → ED → Chairman.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit licindia.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, LTC, Performance Bonus, Staff Welfare
